verdict.rationale: Formant supports the data half of the loop — telemetry ingestion via Agent SDK and data export/querying via the Cloud SDK for data scientists, plus 'scoped research partnerships' — but there's no evidence of an integrated training pipeline or a documented mechanism to push a trained model back onto the fleet as an update. Commands can trigger scripts/actions on robots, which could theoretically be used to deploy a new model, but this is not documented as an ML deployment feature. missing for 10: explicit model-training integration, model versioning/deployment tooling, and documented round-trip (train→deploy) workflow.
